defects.description: The required glossary equivalent for 'brute force attacks' ('атаки методом грубой силы') was not used; the English term was kept instead.
The word 'клетка' (cell/cage) is used instead of 'клиента' (client), which is a hallucination or a severe typo.
Incorrect grammatical case for the list items following the preposition 'для' (should be genitive, but nominative is used throughout the list).
defects.quote: Создание и управление закрытыми ключами, открытыми ключами и параметрами
